title: Projected discards after correcting seating
source: Engine-arena cohorts of 256 games on deterministic boards 0-63 played once per rotation, the candidate and the unchanged depth-2 control in the named slots with an ETA and a fast builder. Runs 901f81f4, dd2a5d1f, 2bae826e, 2f8fae6e, af6fcb03, and 43215190 with the seats swapped; the corrected point is half the difference of the two projection contrasts and the turn-order point half their sum. This figure selects the corrected estimates from the original published asset hand-management-contrasts.json; each swapped pair contains two completed 256-game halves.
caption: The corrected discard effect crosses zero; the seating term remains positive.
